scope: Staged automatic Claude folder-trust input through the existing daemon sampler; synthetic CLI and protocol tests
implementation: The existing 500ms sampler observes a recognized unchanged frame for at least250ms before a single selection movement, then separately observes selected Yes for at least250ms before one Enter. Initially selected Yes needs only the second action.

Each pending attempt binds the exact session instance and shim PID/start tuple. Snapshot capture, current mirror, entry publication and final write revalidate that identity; old callbacks cannot replace or retire a successor attempt.

Foreign input, controller claims, incomplete or changed evidence, lifecycle contention and uncertain effects leave a terminal abandoned/consumed entry. No automatic replay or legacy unbounded-input fallback.

Gate-only try-acquisition uses the existing composer lane and input locks. Its wire frame has a100ms write deadline; partial writes and deadline failures close the stream. Existing ordinary input paths retain their behavior.
regressions: Original implementation fails the first-observation regression by writing combined Down+Enter immediately.
Raw PTY fake CLI rejects combined keys and confirmation before150ms; the staged production tap path passes.
Enter invalidated during its existing observer produces zero wire writes and never retries.
Delayed old-process frames/read errors and parked observations preserve the replacement process attempt and its consumed tombstone.
Busy FIFO, lifecycle, input, direct-input, capability and mirror locks refuse without a queued gate or input effect; the bounded write releases the Stop barrier.
A missing bounded transport interface never falls back to ordinary ControlInput or Input. Stalled real net.Pipe, short writes and deadline failures exercise transport refusal/closure.
